items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: and do you know Kaufman? Bob Kaufman? Poet?

ctx.x: And the whales would come by my grate and they would dance in my front yard and stuff like that, you know. But all the time these poets like Lawrence Ferlinghetti had a place up Bixby Creek. Gary Schneider and all the San Francisco poets and Ken Keasy... and do you know Kaufman? Bob Kaufman? Poet?
